title: A Part Sale side turned on after Set Rule copies the tier's rule
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, with Separate Part Sale pricing off.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click tier A's row on the Tiers list.
  3. Check matrix A.
  4. Type 10 in the bar's value.
  5. Click Set Rule.
  6. Click Set Rule in the dialog.
  7. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  8. Click matrix A's name on the Matrices list.
  9. Click the Part Sale Matrix tab.
  10. Switch Separate Part Sale pricing on.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Tier A is listed.

Step 2:

  • Tier A's page opens.

Step 3:

  • The count is 1.

Step 4:

  • The value reads 10.

Step 5:

  • The question opens.

Step 6:

  • Matrix A's row reads 10% off.

Step 7:

  • Matrix A is listed.

Step 8:

  • Matrix A's page opens on the Work Order Matrix tab.

Step 9:

  • The tab shows the switch, off.

Step 10:

  • The Part Sale grid shows tier A at 10% off in every range.
